cave_guide.text: Wookey Hole is one of the oldest tourist caves in Britain. People have lived in the entrance for 45,000 years. Mind the drips.
The Witch is a rock. The legend says a monk turned her to stone with holy water. I say the damp did it.

cave_diver.text: Cave divers have explored Wookey Hole more than 50 chambers deep. I stay in the shallow end, thanks.
